scientific_limitations: Only finite unnormalized complex Hadamard matrices, one unimodular entry perturbation, and the complex spectral-operator Schur norm are covered.
The real-sign-flip endpoint is prior work; the new contribution is the continuous complex-phase formula, strict phase monotonicity, and local deficit.
Finite optimizer tests are supplementary and not proofs; historical-priority review remains qualified.
title: Universal phase response for one-entry complex Hadamard Schur multipliers
